videos.title: NTHU: AeroSense Airflow Geometry Comparison (2026)
videos.description:
Earlier AeroSense airflow simulation comparing the open chamber, original perforated plate and selected shelf at 1 mL/min. Panels A-C show RK2 tracer trajectories in saved steady velocity fields; the separate scalar panel shows gas advection-diffusion. Twenty seconds of playback represents 60 seconds of modeled advection. Marker density is not gas concentration, and this simulation does not model liquid uptake or cells.

NTHU 2026 AeroSense wiki: https://2026.igem.wiki/nthu/model

videos.title: NTHU: AeroSense Gas Arrival at Liquid Surfaces (2026)
videos.description:
AeroSense gas-transport model comparing chamber geometries at 3 mL/min and then selected-shelf flow rates of 1, 3 and 5 mL/min. Each 30-second chapter represents 0-180 seconds of modeled physical time, with a clock reset between chapters. Concentration maps and fixed-well curves use the same time and C/Cin scale. This is modeled gas concentration next to the liquid boundary, not measured intracellular exposure.

NTHU 2026 AeroSense wiki: https://2026.igem.wiki/nthu/model

videos.title: NTHU: AeroSense Four-Filter Signal Comparison (2026)
videos.description:
Conditional AeroSense detector model comparing no filter, one LEE 101 layer, two LEE 101 layers and an Edmund #29-190 500 nm OD4 longpass scenario. The animation presents received current, filtered ideal current, raw residual and magnified corrected residual. Twenty seconds of playback represents 0.2 seconds of model modulation. These are simulated signals, not PCB or cell measurements.

NTHU 2026 AeroSense wiki: https://2026.igem.wiki/nthu/model

NTHU: AeroSense OR10-Orco Steered Molecular Dynamics (2026) [English]
videos.description:
Saved atomic coordinates from a steered molecular dynamics run show o-cresol in the OR10-Orco complex, alongside ligand-pocket distance and applied bias force. The pulling target follows a lateral candidate route at a nominal 0.20 nm/ns; the 3.610 ns run ends without sustained ligand exit. The gray guide marks a candidate route, not an observed transit path, and the trajectory does not represent spontaneous dissociation.

Prepared for NTHU iGEM 2026 AeroSense. Silent simulation video with English annotations.

Team wiki: https://2026.igem.wiki/nthu/

videos.title: NTHU: AeroSense PN-KC Circuit Simulation - Two Odor Inputs (2026) [English]
videos.description:
Two odor inputs, each activating 20 projection neurons, are compared in a leaky integrate-and-fire PN-KC model displayed on Hemibrain anatomy. Warm colors show projection neurons and green-cyan colors show Kenyon cells; the raster plots show simulated KC spikes. This circuit illustration is separate from calcium-imaging experiments and the AeroSense decoder benchmark.

Prepared for NTHU iGEM 2026 AeroSense. Silent simulation video with English annotations.

Team wiki: https://2026.igem.wiki/nthu/
